# ARC Hollow Frame Fill

## Procedure
1. Identify each monochrome hollow rectangular outline and its bounding box; treat its enclosed cells separately from the outline and background, completing this identification before changing cells.
2. For outlines whose enclosed blank interior is at least 2×2, fill every enclosed cell with color 2 while preserving the border; verify the fill spans exactly the inside of the frame.
3. For a 3×3 ring with one blank center cell, recolor that center to 7 and preserve its eight-cell outline; verify no surrounding background cells changed.
4. Preserve all other cells and the input dimensions, then return the complete grid.

## Evidence
Observed in Continual-ARC task-9b7b853e: hollow frames with 2×2, 4×4, and 6×6 interiors were filled with 2, while hollow 3×3 rings had their center changed to 7. The same mapping held across one demonstration and the solved test instance.
